slug: 2026-05-21 Sudan launches national digital identity SUDAPASS (SUNA)

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications, through the Sudanese Cybersecurity Authority and the National Authority for Electronic Certification, in partnership with the Ministry of Interior's Civil Registry
systems.tiers: national digital identity launched 21 May 2026 for access to government and private e-services, electronic transactions and digital signature

note: The document reports the launch of the national digital identity, with the Civil Registry named as partner; it states nothing about how births or deaths are registered.
